name: Hall Booking Online
shortDescription: A UK cloud booking and invoicing system for church halls, village halls and community venues, operated by Fen Street Designs Ltd.
suitableContexts: Churches hiring out a hall or multiple rooms to the public
Volunteer teams needing online booking requests and invoices
Venues that want an availability calendar embedded in an existing website

pricing.summary: Hall Booking Online publishes a subscription price of £10 per month plus VAT and a free, no-commitment trial. Confirm the current evaluation length, renewal terms and payment-provider charges before purchase.

tiers.label: Hall Booking Online
tiers.detail: Online booking calendar, invoicing, payments, reports, calendar embedding and data export

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier promotes a free, no-commitment trial but does not state the trial duration on the reviewed home page.

gdprInformation: Hall Booking Online identifies its ICO registration (ZB545615), says data is stored on UK/EU servers and publishes individual-rights information. Its policy does not establish current controller/processor roles for church booking data, the exact hosting provider, sub-processors, retention, backup or incident arrangements; obtain the current contractual data-processing pack before use.
coreFeatures: Provisional one-off and repeat booking requests
importExport: Export invoice data for Xero, QuickBooks or Excel
support: Supplier publishes weekday contact hours of 9am to 5pm

uk-operator.value: Hall Booking Online identifies itself as a trading name of Fen Street Designs Ltd, registered in England and Wales under number 14446544. Companies House lists that company as active and classified for software development.

church-hall-scope.value: Supplier publishes an online booking and invoicing system for village halls, church halls and community centres.

pricing.value: Supplier publishes £10 per month plus VAT and a free, no-commitment trial.

data-processing.value: Supplier publishes an ICO registration number and says customer data is stored on UK/EU servers, but current controller/processor roles, sub-processors, retention and incident terms for venue data need supplier documentation.

editorial.assessment: Hall Booking Online is a low-cost UK option for public church-hall hire. It focuses on practical venue administration: public availability, booking requests, invoices, payments, reports and a website calendar. The published £10-per-month price makes it particularly relevant to volunteer-run venues. It is not a church-management system or an internal ministry-room scheduler, and a church should review current data-processing and payment terms before uploading hirer records.
bestFor: Church halls with public and community lettings
Volunteer teams seeking a low-cost booking and invoicing workflow
Venues wanting to embed availability and booking requests in their website
strengths: Named active UK software company and current privacy page
Clear public monthly GBP price and free trial
Booking, invoicing, payment tracking and reporting included
Website calendar integration and export options
limitations: Designed for public venue hire rather than internal church administration
Confirm payment-provider charges, deposits, cancellations and refunds
Obtain current DPA, hosting, sub-processor, retention, backup and exit documentation
Published free-trial duration was not established on the reviewed home page

procurementVerdict.problem: Replacing manual church-hall booking, invoice and availability processes
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A low-cost UK product combining hall-booking calendar, invoices, payment links and website embedding
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Use the trial with a real hall, regular hirer and invoice workflow, then agree the current data-processing and payment responsibilities
